item.title: Zone euro-Les entreprises rencontrent davantage d'obstacles pour obtenir des crédits - enquête BCE
item.description: Les entreprises de la zone euro ont de plus en plus de mal à obtenir des crédits auprès de leurs banques, tandis que la hausse des prix des carburants et des coûts de production pèse sur leurs finances, montre une enquête publiée lundi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les entreprises de la zone euro ont de plus en plus de mal à obtenir des crédits auprès de leurs banques, tandis que la hausse des prix des carburants et des coûts de production pèse sur leurs finances, montre une enquête publiée lundi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE). L'institut de Francfort a relevé ses taux d'intérêt en juin et en septembre afin de freiner l'inflation liée aux prix de l'énergie depuis le début de la guerre au Moyen-Orient, mais elle devrait les maintenir inchangés jeudi afin de recueillir davantage d'informations sur l'impact de la hausse des coûts de financement sur l'économie, tout en tenant compte des tensions sur le marché obligataire. L'enquête trimestrielle sur l'accès au financement des entreprises met en évidence l'apparition de certaines tensions, les entreprises faisant état d'une hausse des taux d'intérêt et d'une diminution de la disponibilité des prêts bancaires. "L'augmentation simultanée et persistante des besoins en crédit commercial et en lignes de crédit suggère que les entreprises sont confrontées à des pressions plus généralisées sur leur fonds de roulement, potentiellement dues à la hausse des coûts des intrants", a déclaré la BCE. "Toutefois, la diminution de la disponibilité des lignes de crédit indique que les banques se montrent plus prudentes dans l'octroi de ce type de financement, ce qui pourrait restreindre davantage la capacité des entreprises à répondre à leurs besoins de financement à court terme", a-t-elle ajouté. La part des entreprises faisant état d'obstacles à l'obtention d'un prêt bancaire est passée à 7% au cours du trimestre clos en septembre, contre 5% au trimestre précédent. L'enquête montre également une forte hausse des anticipations des entreprises en matière de prix, de salaires et d'autres coûts, mais la BCE précise que ces résultats sont faussés par un nombre considérable de nouveaux répondants.

item.title: Packers S Xavier McKinney rips refs after loss to Lions
item.description: Green Bay Packers All-Pro safety Xavier McKinney didn't mince words when describing the officiating after Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Green Bay Packers All-Pro safety Xavier McKinney didn't mince words when describing the officiating after Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions. "I don't know how the NFL's going to treat it, but I'm not a big fan of the refs right now," McKinney said. "I don't think it's great officiating, if I'm being completely honest. I think it's bulls-- a lot of the times." McKinney took issue with a pair of roughing the passer penalties, as well as an unnecessary roughness call on defensive tackle Devonte Wyatt for what was deemed as a late hit on wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown. That play gave the Lions a first down and they scored a touchdown two plays later. "It's annoying even talking about it because these are critical drives throughout the game, and we might have a drive where we're getting stops but you're calling penalties and it's like, this is not a penalty," McKinney said. "To me, it just (doesn't) really make any sense, and it's killing our momentum, it's killing our drives, and it's kind of f--ing up the games, if I'm being honest." McKinney, 28, said he wasn't concerned if the NFL takes issue with his comments and levies a fine. "They gonna fine you for anything at this point in this league, so I would rather get fined and try to help my team out because I see what is going on and I see it's killing us," he said. "We all see it. We all see what's going on. Everyone sees what's going on, the fans see what's going on, we see what's going on when we're out there." Green Bay head coach Matt LaFleur opted to take the high road after the game when asked about the officiating. "I don't even want to comment on any of the penalties," LaFleur said. "It is what it is. You've got to play above it. I thought there were some tough calls, but it is what it is." The Packers (4-3) saw their three-game winning streak come to an end on Sunday. They'll have a short turnaround with Thursday's game against the visiting Carolina Panthers (3-3) on tap. McKinney recorded a season-high 10 tackles on Sunday. He shares the NFL lead with three interceptions to go with 31 tackles and one sack in seven starts this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Após derrota de Vucic, Sérvia aguarda para ver como líderes apoiados por estudantes irão governar
item.description: A Sérvia acordou para uma nova era na segunda-feira, depois que um movimento de protesto apoiado por estudantes derrubou o líder de longa data Aleksandar Vucic em uma vitória eleitoral esmagadora e histórica que provocou comemorações em todo o país, embora poucos tivessem ideia de como iriam governar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Sérvia acordou para uma nova era na segunda-feira, depois que um movimento de protesto apoiado por estudantes derrubou o líder de longa data Aleksandar Vucic em uma vitória eleitoral esmagadora e histórica que provocou comemorações em todo o país, embora poucos tivessem ideia de como iriam governar. Dezenas de milhares de pessoas tomaram as ruas de Belgrado e de outras cidades e municípios por toda a Sérvia depois que Vucic reconheceu a derrota no final do domingo, encerrando dois anos de protestos pacíficos contra o governo que exigiam a renúncia do governante populista. Com quase 99% dos votos apurados, os candidatos dos estudantes garantiram uma vantagem esmagadora de 52,7% dos votos, segundo a Comissão Eleitoral Estadual, contra 39,2% da aliança liderada pelo Partido Progressista Sérvio (SNS), de Vucic. Isso dá aos estudantes 139 cadeiras no Parlamento de 250 cadeiras, deixando a aliança do SNS com 97, e o restante nas mãos de partidos minoritários. “Achei que fosse inacreditável, ainda não acredito nisso. Demorou muito, e (Vucic) vinha nos pressionando há muito, muito tempo”, disse a administradora universitária Marijana Radovanovic Pajovic. Vucic dominou a política sérvia como primeiro-ministro ou presidente desde 2014. Mas foi derrubado do poder por uma lista de candidatos apoiados pelos estudantes, que surgiu a partir de protestos anticorrupção após a morte de 16 pessoas no desabamento da cobertura de uma estação ferroviária na cidade de Novi Sad. A vitória dos estudantes marca uma profunda mudança política no país de cerca de 6 milhões de habitantes e lembra a derrota de Viktor Orbán, da Hungria, em abril. Ela também pode servir de inspiração para outros movimentos estudantis que surgiram por toda a Europa nas últimas semanas, exigindo melhores padrões e perspectivas de educação. No entanto, o movimento, com candidatos que incluem professores universitários, atores e agricultores, não tem líderes claros, e não está claro quem será nomeado para o cargo de primeiro-ministro e para outros cargos-chave a fim de implementar a agenda interna dos estudantes, que visa erradicar a corrupção e melhorar a educação. “Essa corrupção que penetrou em todos os poros de nossas vidas... é claro que vai mudar; esperamos que, aos poucos, sigamos nessa direção de uma comunidade normal”, disse Svetlana Karagkozidou, funcionária de uma seguradora de 60 anos.

item.title: China says it opposes US 'stigmatisation' of Confucius Institutes after Pentagon labels them security threat
item.description: China opposes US "smearing and stigmatisation" of Confucius Institutes, its foreign ministry said on Monday, after the US Defense Department designated the Chinese-funded cultural centres on university campuses as a threat to US national security on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China opposes US "smearing and stigmatisation" of Confucius Institutes, its foreign ministry said on Monday, after the US Defense Department [USN:FWN4692RP TEXT:"designated"] the Chinese-funded cultural centres on university campuses as a threat to US national security on Friday. Educational exchanges between China and the US are mutually beneficial and help deepen mutual understanding, Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told a regular press briefing on Monday when asked about the US designation US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Friday alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating in disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security "It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said The Defense Department over the past two months has "systematically dismantled every single one of these organizations," he said China's official Xinhua news agency on Sunday called the national security threat label "an absurd overreach, exposing some US politicians' warped threat perceptions and their dangerous political calculus of stoking anti-China sentiment ahead of the midterm elections" Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them

item.title: US CFTC, NBA agree to cooperate over basketball and prediction markets
item.description: US regulators and the National Basketball Association entered into a cooperative agreement over prediction markets, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission said on Monday, amid concerns about insider trading and market oversight.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US regulators and the National Basketball Association entered into a cooperative agreement over prediction markets, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission said on Monday, amid concerns about insider trading and market oversight. The two entities agreed to share related information that could have a direct impact on the "integrity" of professional basketball, according to a copy of their memorandum of understanding signed by CFTC Chairman Michael Selig and NBA Commissioner Adam Silver. Representatives for the NBA could not be immediately reached for comment. The pledge follows a recent sports betting scandals that have resulted in lifetime bans from the NBA and other charges, including the arrest of more than 30 people last year in connection with a federal probe into illegal gambling. The CFTC has asserted oversight of prediction markets, arguing they are facilitating trading in a type of financial instrument and reiterated its stance in the agreement released on Monday. Multiple states have sued to block the CFTC's attempt to assert oversight, arguing prediction markets are facilitating gambling and as such their sports bets should be subject to stringent state laws.

item.title: Kenya releases first Ebola contacts from quarantine, milestone in containment efforts
item.description: Kenya on Monday released from quarantine the first group of people who came into contact with its index Ebola patient, a milestone in its efforts to contain cases to a single infection cluster.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya on Monday released from quarantine the first group of people who came into contact with its [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"index Ebola patient"], a milestone in its efforts to contain cases to a single infection cluster. The 20 people released completed 21 days of monitoring without developing Ebola symptoms and are in good health, the director-general in Kenya's health ministry, Patrick Amoth, said in a statement. Kenya has reported nine Ebola cases so far, two of whom have died. The remaining seven patients are stable and receiving treatment, Amoth said, adding that 98 others still in quarantine would be released in four waves beginning on November 3. "This is a milestone worth celebrating," Amoth said. "It is also a reminder that the work is not yet done." Kenya's first case died in a hospital in Nairobi on October 5, after which eight others fell ill while in quarantine. It announced on Friday that a [USN:L6N469174 TEXT:"second person"] had died. Ebola's spread from Congo, where the outbreak was declared in mid-May, to Kenya has raised concerns about lapses in border screening. Nigeria has said its first Ebola case in more than a decade, which it reported last week, appears to be closely related to Kenya's index case, citing genomic analysis. The two cases both flew out of Uganda's Entebbe airport on the same day in early October. Amoth said those leaving quarantine posed no risk to their families or communities where they live and urged Kenyans to welcome them home. "We cannot afford to drop our vigilance," he said.

item.title: Netanyahu destaca respaldo de Trump en vísperas de elección, sugiere que podrían reanudar guerra con Irán
item.description: El primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu se jactó del respaldo de Donald Trump en vísperas de las elecciones en Israel, dando a entender que ambos líderes podrían reanudar su guerra contra Irán si él gana, después de que Trump dijo que deberían "terminar el trabajo".
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Emily Rose
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu se jactó del respaldo de Donald Trump en vísperas de las elecciones en Israel, dando a entender que ambos líderes podrían reanudar su guerra contra Irán si él gana, después de que Trump dijo que deberían "terminar el trabajo". "El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha establecido una amistad que nunca antes había existido entre un primer ministro israelí y un presidente estadounidense. Y es dudoso que volvamos a tener jamás un presidente tan amigo", dijo Netanyahu en una intervención televisada a última hora del domingo por la noche. "Le quedan otros dos años, y dice que les pide que voten por mí". En su propia publicación en las redes sociales del domingo, Trump, quien inició la guerra contra Irán junto con Netanyahu en febrero, dijo: "¡Voten a Bibi Netanyahu para primer ministro, tenemos que terminar el trabajo que empezamos!". Netanyahu dijo que Trump estaba dispuesto a tomar medidas "que, de una vez por todas, acabarían con la amenaza iraní", pero solo mientras el propio Netanyahu permanezca en el poder. "Y ya he dado instrucciones al Mossad y a las Fuerzas de Defensa de Israel (FDI) para que derroquen este régimen, para que derroquen este régimen, porque esa es la única forma de poner fin a esta amenaza", dijo Netanyahu, refiriéndose al principal servicio de inteligencia y al Ejército de Israel. La Casa Blanca no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre las declaraciones de Netanyahu. El principal oponente de Netanyahu, el exjefe del Estado Mayor del Ejército y político centrista Gadi Eisenkot, publicó sus propios comentarios en las redes sociales, elogiando a Trump como "un verdadero amigo de Israel". "Valoro sus esfuerzos y su compromiso con la seguridad de Israel, y estoy seguro de que colaborará plenamente con cualquier líder elegido por el pueblo". EISENKOT ACUSA A NETANYAHU DE ALIMENTAR EL MIEDO La votación del martes, la primera en Israel desde los ataques de Hamás del 7 de octubre de 2023, supone la primera oportunidad para que los votantes emitan un veredicto sobre el peor fracaso en materia de seguridad en generaciones y las guerras en múltiples frentes que le siguieron. Con Netanyahu ya al frente del Gobierno más de extrema derecha de la historia de Israel, la política se ha desplazado aún más hacia la derecha. Casi todos los partidos liderados por judíos, incluido el de Eisenkot, se oponen ahora a la "solución de dos Estados" que sustentó décadas de negociaciones de paz con los palestinos. Sin embargo, muchos votantes dicen que la política divisiva del líder que más tiempo lleva en el poder en Israel debilita al país. Las encuestas sugieren que el Partido Likud de Netanyahu perderá escaños, lo que podría privar a su coalición —formada por partidos de derecha, extrema derecha y ultraortodoxos— de su estrecha mayoría. Eisenkot y una serie de partidos de la oposición —que van desde lo que queda de la centroizquierda hasta la derecha— tampoco tienen un camino claro para desbancarlo. Netanyahu, de 77 años, es un maestro sin igual de la supervivencia política: la única vez desde 2009 que sus oponentes lograron arrebatarle brevemente el cargo de primer ministro, hicieron falta cuatro elecciones inconclusas en dos años para apartarlo del poder. Regresó 18 meses después. Ninguna de las partes tenía previsto celebrar grandes actos públicos para el lunes. Sin embargo, ambas publicaron mensajes en las redes sociales, insistiendo en los temas principales de la campaña electoral: por parte de Netanyahu, que es el único líder con el temple necesario para plantar cara a los enemigos de Israel; por parte de sus oponentes, que su política divisiva ha debilitado al país. Netanyahu compartió el lunes un video generado por IA del líder supremo de Irán, el ayatolá Mojtaba Jamenei, cuyo padre, Ali Jamenei, fue asesinado la primera noche de los ataques estadounidenses e israelíes contra Irán en febrero. Tumbado en una cama de hospital, el joven Jamenei dice que su voto "definitivamente no sería para Bibi. Otro mandato como este y me reuniré con mi padre antes de lo esperado". El domingo, Netanyahu publicó una foto generada por computador de una nube en forma de hongo sobre Tel Aviv, afirmando que Israel se encontraba en peligro existencial por culpa de Irán. Eisenkot respondió acusándole de "recurrir a una campaña de alarmismo, mentiras y amenazas —incluidas imágenes de bombas nucleares en el corazón de Tel Aviv—. Esta vez, no le va a funcionar". El respaldo de Trump a Netanyahu conlleva sus propios riesgos políticos una semana antes de unas elecciones legislativas en las que los republicanos buscan mantenerse en el poder. La guerra con Irán es profundamente impopular en Estados Unidos, ya que se la culpa del aumento de los precios, especialmente del combustible. Los combates importantes llevan meses suspendidos tras las negociaciones de alto el fuego celebradas sin la participación de Israel.

item.title: Reuters becomes exclusive third-party distributor of iconic Sky News archive
item.description: Reuters today announced a partnership with Sky News to exclusively distribute its archive, further strengthening Reuters Connect as a one-stop-shop for documentary filmmakers, production companies, broadcasters, publishers and other media organizations looking for comprehensive content.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Communications
item.content:encoded: More than 150,000 clips from the Sky News archive spanning every major news event of the last 35 years available via Reuters Royal collection alone includes 40,000 clips documenting key moments Easy discoverability through AI-powered search on Reuters Connect Reuters today announced a partnership with Sky News to exclusively distribute its archive, further strengthening Reuters Connect as a one-stop-shop for documentary filmmakers, production companies, broadcasters, publishers and other media organizations looking for comprehensive content. Reuters Connect users now have access to more than 150,000 Sky News archival clips alongside content from Reuters and 100+ other content providers, reinforcing Reuters Connect’s position as the leading multimedia licensing platform for professional content creators, documentary makers and media organizations worldwide. With AI-powered search on the platform, content is easily discoverable, making licensing of content faster and more efficient. The Sky News archive contains more than 35 years of news material dating back to the channel's launch on 5 February 1989, capturing pivotal moments that have defined our world to bring audiences the full story, first – from the fall of the Berlin Wall and the death of Princess Diana, to the COVID-19 pandemic and the war in Ukraine. Approximately 90% of the collection comprises raw, unbranded footage with natural sound and no reporter voiceover, much of which has never been broadcast. The archive spans decades of eyewitness international coverage across multiple continents, with material drawn from Sky News bureaus worldwide and across the UK. "The Sky News archive is an extraordinary historical resource and adds to more than a century’s-worth of licensable content on Reuters Connect," said Alphonse Hardel, Head of Reuters News Agency. "The platform provides the full depth of history and the breadth of global coverage in one place, with AI-powered search to make it all discoverable and useable for content creators across multiple industries." The archive's breadth is remarkable. The Royal Family collection alone encompasses approximately 40,000 clips documenting official engagements, weddings, births, funerals and other significant moments. Political coverage captures key figures and turning points from the UK, US and beyond, while war and conflict footage documents every major global conflict since 1989, from Sarajevo to Syria and Ukraine. The archive also includes extensive material on crime and justice, sport, extreme weather and natural disasters, global health coverage, business and economics, arts and entertainment, and travel and transport. A specialized Creative Collection of more than 5,500 artistically composed clips – shot without logos or recognizable people – opens additional possibilities for advertising, corporate and editorial applications. Andrew Thomson, Executive Director of Business Operations, Sky News, said: “For more than 35 years, Sky News has brought audiences the full story, first, reporting from the heart of the moments that have shaped Britain and the world. Our archive captures that first draft of history, from royal occasions and political milestones to conflicts, natural disasters and major global events. This partnership with Reuters will help elevate this extraordinary collection, built on decades of impartial, on-the-ground eyewitness reporting, making it accessible to a global community of filmmakers, producers, broadcasters and content creators.” For more information on licensing Sky News archive content, visit Reuters Connect . item.title: Ibovespa desaba mais de 15% em pregão com circuit breaker após reeleição de Lula
item.description: O Ibovespa desabava nesta segunda-feira, com a B3 acionando o mecanismo de "circuit breaker" nos primeiros minutos do pregão, após reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva na véspera, que contrariou as expectativas do mercado e trazia preocupações com o cenário fiscal do país.

item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa desabava nesta segunda-feira, com a B3 acionando o mecanismo de "circuit breaker" nos primeiros minutos do pregão, após reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva na véspera, que contrariou as expectativas do mercado e trazia preocupações com o cenário fiscal do país. item.title: Tensões entre Coreias estão em alta após cartas enviadas à ONU e avistamento de obuses
item.description: As tensões entre a Coreia do Norte e a Coreia do Sul estão em alta nesta semana, depois que Pyongyang enviou uma carta ao Conselho de Segurança da ONU, reiterando as acusações de que Seul teria inventado um incidente envolvendo minas terrestres ocorrido em setembro, e após obuses norte-coreanos terem sido avistados perto da fronteira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As tensões entre a Coreia do Norte e a Coreia do Sul estão em alta nesta semana, depois que Pyongyang enviou uma carta ao Conselho de Segurança da ONU, reiterando as acusações de que Seul teria inventado um incidente envolvendo minas terrestres ocorrido em setembro, e após obuses norte-coreanos terem sido avistados perto da fronteira. Uma testemunha da Reuters em um observatório na Coreia do Sul, com vista para a fronteira fortemente armada, avistou na segunda-feira três veículos blindados norte-coreanos posicionados em local bem visível perto da fronteira. A agência de notícias sul-coreana Yonhap identificou na segunda-feira os três veículos como obuses autopropulsados de 122 mm, afirmando que sua mobilização perto da fronteira representou uma rara exibição pública desse tipo de artilharia. Os três veículos blindados norte-coreanos tinham os canos dos canhões apontados para o sul, e a Reuters também observou cerca de 20 a 30 soldados norte-coreanos realizando trabalhos de instalação de cercas dentro da Zona Desmilitarizada (DMZ). “É altamente incomum (para a Coreia do Norte) expor sua artilharia autopropulsada de forma tão ostensiva”, disse Lim Eul-chul, professor da Universidade Kyungnam, em Seul. “Ao exibi-la deliberadamente, a Coreia do Norte está sinalizando por meio de ações, e não de palavras, que pretende fazer valer sua política de fronteira pela força, em vez de diálogo ou negociação.” Além disso, está alertando a Coreia do Sul para que tenha cautela em relação à escalada de atritos na fronteira, com o objetivo de evitar um confronto acidental, acrescentou ele. A agência de notícias estatal norte-coreana KCNA informou que, na carta enviada no domingo, o representante do país na ONU afirmou que Seul estava usando o incidente com as minas terrestres para retratar a construção da fronteira por Pyongyang como uma incursão militar. A Coreia do Norte advertiu na carta que violações de sua soberania poderiam desencadear medidas de autodefesa e que a Coreia do Sul seria “totalmente responsável por todas as consequências decorrentes”. A carta é uma resposta a uma carta da Coreia do Sul ao Conselho de Segurança na semana passada, na qual se afirmava que uma explosão ocorrida em 21 de setembro na Zona Desmilitarizada foi provocada por tropas norte-coreanas e constituía uma violação do Acordo de Armistício da Guerra da Coreia. O Comando da ONU, que supervisiona a Zona Desmilitarizada, afirmou que uma mina norte-coreana do outro lado da linha violou o armistício. Pyongyang negou responsabilidade. O Comando da ONU declarou na segunda-feira que não comentaria atividades militares específicas.

item.title: Pedido de abertura de capital da Anthropic revela crescimento explosivo, riscos e custos astronômicos
item.description: A Anthropic divulgou perdas acentuadas e um crescimento vertiginoso da receita em seu pedido de abertura de capital nos EUA nesta segunda-feira, ao apresentar sua ambição de construir sistemas de IA capazes de remodelar a economia global, apesar dos altos custos de desenvolvimento da tecnologia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic divulgou perdas acentuadas e um crescimento vertiginoso da receita em seu pedido de abertura de capital nos EUA nesta segunda-feira, ao apresentar sua ambição de construir sistemas de IA capazes de remodelar a economia global, apesar dos altos custos de desenvolvimento da tecnologia. O prospecto destaca o rápido crescimento da Anthropic ao longo do último ano, impulsionado pelos gastos vertiginosos das grandes empresas de tecnologia, que provocaram uma alta nas ações do setor de IA, ao mesmo tempo em que geraram preocupações com as valorizações elevadas e o aumento da dívida. No primeiro semestre de 2026, o prejuízo líquido aumentou drasticamente para US$80,7 bilhões, em grande parte devido a um aumento no valor justo dos títulos conversíveis em ações da empresa. A receita nesse período foi de cerca de US$16,3 bilhões. A receita da Anthropic cresceu impressionantes 1.368% nos três meses encerrados em 30 de junho, em comparação com o mesmo período do ano anterior. Espera-se que a oferta pública inicial (IPO) consagre a Anthropic, o laboratório de IA por trás dos modelos virais do Claude, como referência para a forma como Wall Street avalia as principais empresas de IA, incluindo a rival OpenAI. A Anthropic segue em frente com seus planos de IPO mesmo com o calendário de listagens do outono — antes bastante movimentado — tendo ficado mais esparso, com a volatilidade do mercado levando as empresas a adiar suas ofertas. O IPO daria à Anthropic acesso a um vasto pacote de capital para financiar suas ambições onerosas em IA, que exigem pesados investimentos em infraestrutura de computação para desenvolver e operar modelos sofisticados. As ações globais sofreram uma forte correção à medida que os investidores ficam cada vez mais apreensivos com o boom de investimentos em IA alimentado por dívidas e começam a duvidar se os trilhões que estão sendo injetados em centros de dados, chips e capacidade computacional gerarão retornos rápidos o suficiente para sustentar as avaliações elevadas. Custos mais altos de financiamento e rendimentos crescentes dos títulos aumentaram ainda mais a cautela dos investidores. Alguns investidores atuais e potenciais estão avaliando a Anthropic em cerca de US$1,5 trilhão, abaixo dos aproximadamente US$2 trilhões de uma semana atrás, depois que a startup de IA divulgou alguns detalhes financeiros em um evento recente para investidores, informou a Reuters. (Reportagem de Manya Saini em Bengaluru e Echo Wang em Nova York)

item.title: Real brasileño se hunde más de 12% tras reelección de Lula
item.description: El real brasileño se debilitó más de un 12,2% el lunes, a 5,60 unidades por dólar, después de que el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva fue reelegido el domingo en el balotaje frente al senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro.
item.dc:creator: Fabricio Castro
item.content:encoded: El real brasileño se debilitó más de un 12,2% el lunes, a 5,60 unidades por dólar, después de que el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva [USN:L5N46C0UF TEXT:"fue reelegido"] el domingo en el balotaje frente al senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro. Las operaciones en el mercado de futuros del dólar, el de mayor liquidez en Brasil y que sirve de referencia para las cotizaciones en el mercado al contado, sufrieron interrupciones por la mañana, después de que la bolsa B3 limitó las oscilaciones para permitir que el mercado encontrara un precio de equilibrio. El real perdía un 11% , a 5,5394 unidades por dólar la venta a las 1341 GMT. La cotización a futuro para noviembre se hundía más de un 11%, alcanzando los 5,5380 reales. Durante la mañana, la B3 anunció una modificación en los límites de oscilación diaria para todos los vencimientos en la sesión del lunes, pasando del 6% al 8,4%. Posteriormente, emitió un nuevo comunicado ampliándolo al 12%. Lula ganó la contienda presidencial con el 51,79% de los votos válidos, frente al 48,21%del senador Bolsonaro. Dado que el mercado estaba, en gran medida, posicionado ante una posible victoria de Flávio Bolsonaro, el ajuste que se registra es potente.

item.title: VIEW Anthropic IPO filing to put AI investment boom to the test
item.description: Anthropic made its US IPO filing public on Monday, edging toward what could be the first stock market debut by a frontier AI lab and laying out the promise, costs and risks of building AI meant to transform the global economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic made its [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"US IPO filing"] public on Monday, edging toward what could be the first stock market debut by a frontier AI lab and laying out the promise, costs and risks of building AI meant to transform the global economy. The IPO comes at a time when market volatility has thinned the fall listing calendar and rising borrowing costs have sharpened investor concerns over the debt-fueled AI investment boom. Wall Street's main indexes were higher in morning trade with the S&P 500 (.SPX) up 0.5%. U.S. stock index futures got a brief boost after the IPO filing. COMMENTS: JOSH STEVENS, CHIEF INVESTMENT OFFICER, CRESALTA INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT, COLORADO "I'm optimistic about AI as a technology. And Anthropic is certainly exciting. But are we going to rush in and buy at the IPO? No. Even great ideas or business models end up seeing their share prices come down to attractive levels during times when investors are reassessing demand and supply. And then, you've got an opportunity to go in and buy." PETER ANDERSEN, FOUNDER OF ANDERSEN CAPITAL MANAGEMENT, BOSTON "I think it's a significant milestone in the development of artificial intelligence. And the outcome of this IPO will be fairly indicative of the sentiment for continuing to support capital expenditures in the development of artificial intelligence." THOMAS HAYES, CHAIRMAN, GREAT HILL CAPITAL, NEW YORK "In the general sense of a business doing $16 or $32 billion annualized revenue, and losing $80 to $160 billion a year, a $1.5 trillion valuation seems rich. The offering is for the faithful, that sooner or later, they're going to get some return on that invested capital. The price could go up because they'll control the supply of stock that they issued, but in the long term, it's a weighing machine and losing that amount of money on that investment until they turn the corner, which is many years out, you'll have better places to buy it than at the initial public offering." "If people are raising cash for the Anthropic IPO with funds from the current hyperscalers in Mag Seven, that could be a headwind in coming weeks. It will be dependent on what we see in earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, and Amazon this week." BRIAN MULBERRY, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST, ZACKS INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT, COLORADO "It'll be very interesting because Meta has come out and said we're going to raise another $95 billion in an equity offering as well, so you're going to have really a saturated market. There's a lot of liquidity that needs to get scooped up by these two offerings at the same time. I think it could be a detrimental to some of these smaller and maybe even lower quality AI names that are out there." LUKAS MUEHLBAUER, ASSOCIATE AT IPOX SCHUSTER, EDINBURGH "Anthropic’s IPO will certainly establish a benchmark for valuing leading AI labs, influencing both upcoming listings and confidence in the companies funding the AI infrastructure buildout." "Its success would not necessarily benefit every AI business equally, as investors will still distinguish between proven customer demand and spending based on anticipated growth." ANDRE BAKHOS, MANAGING MEMBER, INGENIUM ANALYTICS LLC IN PLAINSBORO, NEW JERSEY "It speaks a lot that the AI trade is alive and well. That the penetration of AI will continue. It also bolsters the psychology looking at the other participants in this space." "It's a race for capital and it's telling that there is growth. But also there are going to be questions coming in regarding valuations, regarding how long can this go for." ROBERT PAVLIK, SENIOR PORTFOLIO MANAGER, DAKOTA WEALTH IN FAIRFIELD, CONNECTICUT "It's a challenging environment, to say the least, exactly when this IPO will take place. There's a lot riding on not only the company, but the AI industry." "If it goes well, that could help return investors confidence to the AI industry. But it's going to be challenging." "Maybe the environment changes after the (US midterm) elections next week. You're going to have to make major promises that I don't know if they can be fulfilled anytime soon." MATT KENNEDY, SENIOR STRATEGIST AT RENAISSANCE CAPITAL "Investors weren't questioning valuations the same way a few months ago. With some of the hottest AI IPOs of the summer trading below their offer price, not even Anthropic will get a blank check." "Maybe they could have gotten a higher valuation next year, but they've decided to 'rip the band-aid off'." "For Anthropic, being publicly traded is also of strategic interest: This is a PBC (Public Benefit Corporation), and being publicly traded provides a greater level of public transparency."

item.title: SpaceX firma un acuerdo de 40.000 millones de dólares con Apollo para financiar chips de IA
item.description: SpaceX anunció el lunes que una filial de Apollo Global Management comprará chips de inteligencia artificial y hardware de servidores y se los alquilará a la empresa, dedicada tanto a cohetes como a la IA, en una operación cuyo importe total del capital asciende a unos 40.000 millones de dólares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) anunció el lunes que una filial de Apollo Global Management (APO.N) comprará chips de inteligencia artificial y hardware de servidores y se los alquilará a la empresa, dedicada tanto a cohetes como a la IA, en una operación cuyo importe total del capital asciende a unos 40.000 millones de dólares. Cada contrato de arrendamiento tendrá una duración de algo más de cinco años a partir de la fecha de entrega del equipo, según un documento presentado ante las autoridades reguladoras. El acuerdo pone de relieve el elevado gasto de SpaceX, que intenta aprovechar la creciente demanda de potencia de cálculo para financiar sus ambiciones en la Luna y Marte. La empresa tiene como objetivo cerrar el acuerdo antes de que termine el año. Se espera que los arrendamientos comiencen en el primer semestre de 2027, una vez que se hayan entregado los chips. El domingo, el director ejecutivo, Elon Musk, dijo en la red social X que SpaceX había "cerrado" una financiación mediante deuda por valor de 40.000 millones de dólares para la adquisición de unidades de procesamiento gráfico. Musk señaló que la financiación se destinaba principalmente a los chips que llegarían en el primer y segundo trimestre y que no supondría "un factor importante este trimestre". El director financiero, Bret Johnsen, había señalado que SpaceX sigue previendo unos gastos de capital para el cuarto trimestre de entre 35.000 y 40.000 millones de dólares. Reuters informó a principios de este mes de que SpaceX estaba en negociaciones con bancos y gestores de activos para recaudar 40.000 millones de dólares con el fin de adquirir chips de Nvidia. (NVDA.O)

item.title: Napoli coach Allegri handed two-match ban over outbursts in Roma clash
item.description: Napoli coach Max Allegri has been handed a two-match ban for abusive remarks and an aggressive attitude towards match officials and an AS Roma staff member being sent off during Saturday's 3-3 home draw, Serie A's sports judge said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Napoli coach Max Allegri has been handed a two-match ban for abusive remarks and an aggressive attitude towards match officials and an AS Roma staff member being sent off during [USN:L2N46A049 TEXT:"Saturday's 3-3 home draw"], Serie A's sports judge said on Monday. Allegri was dismissed shortly after Leonardo Balerdi scored a late equaliser for Roma. Allegri, who believed there was a foul during the build-up, reacted with anger when the VAR cleared the goal, leading to a straight red card. The manager, who has also been fined €10,000 ($11,200), is set to miss the Serie A games at Monza on Wednesday and Juventus on Sunday as his 10th-placed Napoli side look for a turnaround after winning only one of their last four league matches. Allegri made an "abusive remark towards the match officials" and later, in the changing room, "adopted an aggressive attitude towards an official of the opposing team," the disciplinary authority said in a decision published on the league's website. "Offences (were) noted by the fourth official (Juan Luca Sacchi) and the referee (Andrea Colombo), and the latter by officials from the Federal Prosecutor’s Office," the sports judge added. Allegri in a post-match interview denied having abused the match officials. "The fourth official called the referee and got me sent off but I said absolutely nothing," he told DAZN Italia. ($1 = 0.8925 euros)

item.title: CEO da Audi enfrenta reações negativas após se juntar a Trump em comício
item.description: O presidente-executivo da Audi, Gernot Doellner, foi alvo de duras críticas nesta segunda-feira por ter aparecido ao lado do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, em um comício de campanha no estado disputado da Geórgia, com o líder do principal sindicato alemão afirmando que isso violou as diretrizes da montadora.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente-executivo da Audi, Gernot Doellner, foi alvo de duras críticas nesta segunda-feira por ter aparecido ao lado do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, em um comício de campanha no estado disputado da Geórgia, com o líder do principal sindicato alemão afirmando que isso violou as diretrizes da montadora. Doellner apareceu ao lado de Trump no comício em Perry, perto de Macon, na região central da Geórgia, para anunciar planos de construir uma fábrica de US$4 bilhões — a primeira da montadora de carros de luxo nos EUA —, que produziria 200 mil SUVs por ano. O presidente de um importante sindicato o acusou de violar o código de conduta da empresa com essa participação. O investimento deve ser submetido ao conselho fiscal da controladora Volkswagen , que inclui representantes trabalhistas alemães. COMITÊ DA VW DEVE DECIDIR SOBRE FÁBRICA NOS EUA A decisão de seguir adiante com o investimento viria após longas deliberações sobre uma fábrica nos EUA para escapar das tarifas de importação que custaram à Audi cerca de 1,2 bilhão de euros no ano passado. “Doellner também está violando flagrantemente as regras de sua própria empresa, que exigem expressamente neutralidade política no período que antecede as eleições”, afirmou Christiane Benner, presidente do sindicato alemão IG Metall e vice-presidente do conselho fiscal da Volkswagen. Benner ressaltou que qualquer decisão sobre o investimento deve, em última instância, ser tomada pelo comitê supervisor superior, que já está repleto de tensões devido à ampla reestruturação da Volkswagen. Trump já manifestou apoio, no passado, ao partido de extrema direita Alternativa para a Alemanha (AfD), o que o torna um aliado polêmico para a corrente dominante na política e no mundo empresarial alemão. TRUMP ANSIOSO POR PROMOVER IMPACTO DAS TARIFAS O especialista alemão em automotivo Ferdinand Dudenhoeffer se referiu a Doellner como um “mini Elon Musk”, comparando-o ao chefe da Tesla, que já subiu ao palco com Trump. O código de conduta da Audi estipula que não devem ocorrer “compromissos públicos com partidos políticos ou políticos candidatos a eleições, nem qualquer patrocínio a tais eventos” nos três meses que antecedem uma eleição. Trump está ansioso para defender que suas tarifas sobre automóveis estão ajudando a economia dos EUA antes das eleições de meio de mandato. O plano de investimentos dos EUA coincide com a iniciativa da Volkswagen de cortar 100 mil empregos e reduzir drasticamente o excesso de produção, enquanto a empresa enfrenta pesadas perdas na China e absorve tarifas elevadas e a dispendiosa transição para veículos elétricos. As unidades de produção alemãs do grupo têm estado sob pressão especial para reduzir custos, sendo a fábrica da Audi em Neckarsulm uma das quatro unidades ameaçadas de fechamento a partir do início da próxima década. “A imagem não é das melhores: empregos estão sendo criados nos EUA enquanto a Audi reduz sua capacidade globalmente”, afirmaram analistas da Metzler sobre o plano dos EUA. “Ainda assim, consideramos que a decisão de produzir nos EUA é acertada.”

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street vue dans le vert, le recul du pétrole rassure avant une semaine cruciale
item.description: Wall Street est attendue en hausse et les Bourses européennes restent dans le vert à mi-séance, le recul des cours pétroliers redonnant espoir en amont d'une slave de résultats d'entreprises et de décisions de politique monétaire.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Wall Street est attendue en hausse et les Bourses européennes restent dans le vert à mi-séance, le recul des cours pétroliers redonnant espoir en amont d'une slave de résultats d'entreprises et de décisions de politique monétaire. Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture de Wall Street en hausse de 0,45% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , de 0,41% pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et de 0,73% pour le Nasdaq (.IXIC) . À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) gagne 0,86% à 7.849,76 points vers 12h06 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) avance de 1,00% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) monte de 0,41%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) progresse de 0,73%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,51% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,54%. Alors que la saison des résultats trimestriels s'apprête à battre son plein et que plusieurs réunions de politique monétaire se tiennent cette semaine, les efforts de médiation pour apaiser les tensions au Moyen-Orient participent au recul des cours pétroliers et au regain d'optimisme des opérateurs. Les principaux contrats de brut restent toutefois proches de leurs plus hauts niveaux depuis six mois, dans l'attente d'annonces émanant des pourparlers en cours à Téhéran, alors que des attaques se sont poursuivies dans la région ce week-end. Sur le plan de la politique monétaire, les marchés anticipent largement un statu quo sur les taux de la part des principales banques centrales, avec une probabilité de 91% pour la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) jeudi et de 90% pour la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) mercredi, selon les données LSEG. Les investisseurs resteront toutefois attentifs aux commentaires ressortant des réunions, afin d'affiner leurs perspectives. En parallèle, l'agence de notation Moody's a décidé [USN:L8N46923J TEXT:"vendredi"] de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1". La décision contribue lundi à l'apaisement de la vague de ventes sur le marché obligataire français, bien que la prudence reste de mise face à l'incertitude persistante de la situation politique en France. Alors que les investisseurs s'inquiètent du niveau de la dette publique française, les contestations sociales jettent le doute sur la marge de manoeuvre pour assainir les finances françaises à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle, tandis que les parlementaires débattent actuellement le bugdet 2027. La nouvelle journée mobilisation de samedi contre la vie chère et pour l'amélioration des conditions d'étude s'est déroulée globalement dans le calme en comparaison à celle du 17 octobre, marquée par les pillages et violences en marge des cortèges. Le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez, a toutefois déclaré [USN:L5N46C0E7 TEXT:"lundi"] que le gouvernement s'attendait à un nouvel acte de mobilisation "compliqué" samedi prochain, le 31 octobre, avec également la soirée d'Halloween. LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L5N46C0HY] Avec le passage dans la nuit de samedi à dimanche à l'heure d'hiver en Europe, la Bourse de New York ouvrira à 14h30 heure de Paris à compter de lundi, au lieu de 15h30 à l'heure d'été. VALEURS EN EUROPE À Paris, les valeurs exposées au Brésil triment face à la victoire surprise du président sortant Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva à l'élection présidentielle, les investisseurs réévaluant leurs perspectives alors que les sondages donnaient favori le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro. Edenred (EDEN.PA) et Pluxee (PLX.PA) reculent respectivement de 1,2% et 2,3%. La banque espagnole Santander (SAN.MC) , qui tire environ 15% de ses bénéfices au Brésil, selon Citi, perd 2,8%. Lanterne rouge du SBF 120, GTT (GTT.PA) chute de 13% à la suite de ses résultats publiés [USN:FWN4692V7 TEXT:"vendredi soir"] et d'un abaissement de la recommandation sur le titre par Bernstein. TAUX Le marché obligataire français marque une désescalade, aidé par le maintien surprise de la note de crédit Moody's sur la France alors qu'une dégradation était largement anticipée, en plus d'un nouvel acte de mobilisation sociale samedi plus calme que la semaine précédente. Le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans perd 4,5 points de base à 4,9763%. Le deux ans cède pour sa part 1,0 point de base à 3,7617%. Outre-Rhin, Le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans gagne quant à lui 3,2 points de base à 3,3747%. Le deux ans augmente de 4,8 points de base à 3,0751%. Le "spread", ou écart de rendement, entre les obligations allemandes et françaises à dix ans se resserre ainsi d'environ 6 points de base (pdb), à 160 pdb, après avoir dépassé le seuil des 170 pdb la semaine dernière. Outre-Atlantique, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 1,3 point de base à 5,0008%. Le deux ans progresse quant à lui de 2,8 points de base à 4,7095%. CHANGES Le marché des devises évolue sur de faibles variations, les cambistes restant sur la réserve à l'aube des réunions de politique monétaire des principales banques centrales. Le dollar grappille 0,05% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro abandonne 0,05% à 1,1196 dollar . PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers reculent dans un contexte d'espoir d'apaisement des tensions entre les États-Unis et l'Iran, même si les attaques persistantes contre l'Arabie saoudite contribuent à la prudence des investisseurs et à maintenir les contrats proches de leurs plus hauts niveaux depuis six mois. Des médiateurs qatariens se sont rendus dimanche à Téhéran dans le cadre d’une initiative visant à apaiser les tensions régionales, en coordination avec les États-Unis, a déclaré un responsable au fait de la situation. Par ailleurs, de hauts responsables des pays signataires du Pacte de La Mecque – l’Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan – doivent rencontrer lundi à Téhéran les dirigeants iraniens. Malgré ces pourparlers de médiation, les attaques se sont poursuivies tout au long du week-end, les Houthis affirmant avoir frappé des stations de pompage sur l’oléoduc est-ouest de l’Arabie saoudite ainsi que l’aéroport de Riyad. L’Arabie saoudite a déclaré dimanche avoir intercepté d’autres missiles et drones. Le Brent perd 1,74% à 114,69 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) lâche 2,2% à 101,00 dollars. ÉMERGENTS Les marchés brésiliens s'apprêtent à subir lundi une forte vague de ventes après la réélection de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, bouleversant les anticipations des investisseurs qui tablaient sur une victoire de la droite. Les contrats à terme signalent une chute d'environ 15% à l'ouverture pour l'indice boursier de référence brésilien, le Bovespa . "Une partie de cette réaction s'explique donc davantage par un débouclage rapide des positions prises par les investisseurs que par une dégradation soudaine des fondamentaux de l'économie brésilienne", a écrit dans une note Lale Akoner, analyste de marchés chez etoro, estimant que "la forte correction des marchés pourrait également créer des opportunités pour les investisseurs". Les contrats à terme de novembre sur le real brésilien reculent de plus de 10%. item.title: New UK nuclear rules pave way for US reactor developers
item.description: UK-U.S. nuclear rapport is providing American small modular reactor (SMR) developers with an accelerated regulatory pathway to expand into Britain.
item.dc:creator: Neil Ford
item.content:encoded: Great Britain is overhauling nuclear regulation just as U.S. developers step up plans for projects in the UK. Electricity demand in Britain is forecast to rise by 40% by 2035, according to the National Energy System Operator. The British government aims to conclude an overhaul of its nuclear regulations by the end of 2027, as part of efforts to quadruple nuclear output to 24 GW by 2050. The Office for Nuclear Regulation (ONR), Environment Agency (EA) and Natural Resources Wales (NRW) aim to cut reactor design approval periods from roughly three or four years to around two years. The UK-U.S. Atlantic Partnership for Advanced Nuclear Energy, signed in September 2025 to "turbocharge" the deployment of next-generation nuclear technology, could help achieve that target. It enables the two countries to share regulatory assessments for new reactor applications to avoid duplicating work. CHART: UK nuclear power capacity Source: World Nuclear Association Efforts to streamline regulations follow the 2025 Nuclear Regulatory Review, which identified fragmented oversight, "overly conservative and costly” regulatory decisions, and unnecessarily complex legislation as major obstacles to nuclear development. It made 47 recommendations, such as better coordination between regulators, more proportionate safety assessments, and a fleet-based approach that would reduce repeated scrutiny of identical reactor designs. The government also wants to streamline planning and environmental approvals for nuclear projects, which have contributed to long development times and high costs. These reforms could allow leading U.S. small modular reactor (SMR) developers, including Holtec, TerraPower, Westinghouse, and X-energy, to gain a foothold in the rapidly growing British market. Holtec’s test case Holtec will provide an early test case on whether bilateral cooperation can accelerate regulatory approvals. UK authorities have identified Holtec’s two-unit SMR-300 project at Palisades , Michigan, as the input reference design for the company’s Generic Design Assessment (GDA) – a regulatory review of a nuclear reactor design’s safety, security and environmental acceptability, independent of a specific site. The regulatory reviews that would allow Holtec to obtain a GDA for the SMR-300 reactor will therefore draw on information and analysis developed for Palisades. Holtec submitted its Preliminary Safety Analysis Report for Palisades to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) on September 30. “Our intention is to apply the U.S. design and safety analysis in the UK,” said Patrick O’Brien, Executive Director, Government Affairs and Communications at Holtec International. Holtec wants to treat its U.S. and British ventures as “a single continuous deployment rather than two separate engineering projects,” O’Brien told Reuters Events. Join 1,500+ senior decision-makers across energy and finance at Reuters Events Energy LIVE 2026 . Holtec completed Step 2 of the GDA for its SMR-300 with the three British regulators – ONR, EA and NRW – in March 2026. The company plans to deploy up to four SMR-300s with EDF and Tritax at Cottam, a former coal-fired power station in Nottinghamshire, in the East Midlands, providing around 1.3 GW of generating capacity. Replicating the Palisades project would reduce first-of-a-kind engineering risks and improve schedule and cost predictability, O’Brien said. Cottam could therefore provide “a test case” of how effectively ONR and NRC can work together to improve regulatory timescales and efficiency, Simon Stuttaford, Partner at law firm White & Case, told Reuters Events. It remains to be seen whether projects that have already obtained a design license in the U.S., or feature “more mature” nuclear technology, can move rapidly through the GDA regulatory process, Stuttaford said. “A lot of this will turn on the willingness of the ONR to accept or otherwise regulatory information from the U.S.,” he added. Regulatory recognition Westinghouse’s 300 MW AP300 reactor entered the GDA process in August 2024. TerraPower’s Natrium reactor formally began the GDA application process in June 2026, and X-energy's Xe-100 in September. TerraPower has not yet chosen a site for its first UK deployment, but the company’s CEO, Chris Levesque told Reuters in September that by "2034 nuclear electricity in the UK from Natrium is very possible." It would be the first Natrium reactor outside the U.S., the company said. The GDA remains rigorous, covering safety, security, safeguards and environmental acceptability, an X-energy spokesperson told Reuters Events. However, its generic nature allows developers to establish that their technology “is acceptable early in the development and deployment process before significant site-specific expenditure is incurred,” the spokesperson said. X-energy sees a parallel with NRC standard design certification, where projects can reference a technology-level assessment rather than revisit every design question, the spokesperson said. “The practical opportunity is licensing efficiency: reducing duplication by recognising work already done under U.S. assessments,” they noted. X-energy has chosen Centrica as its partner to develop up to 6 GW of UK advanced nuclear capacity, starting with a proposed 12-reactor, 960 MW project at Hartlepool in northeast England. Centrica owns 20% of Britain’s operational nuclear fleet and holds a 15% stake in the 3.2 GW Sizewell C project in Suffolk. The X-energy spokesperson described the partnership as “genuinely market-leading,” in part because Centrica is an experienced nuclear developer with access to capital and a long-term presence across energy assets, they said. Download our exclusive report on U.S. grid investment trends. X-energy is working with ONR and NRC to map U.S. assessments onto UK requirements. ONR, EA and NRW’s May 2026 Leveraging International Regulators’ Judgements Policy is a legal framework that allows these regulatory agencies to use assessments by trusted overseas bodies. ONR is increasingly willing to use work already undertaken by the U.S. NRC, potentially making parts of GDA “confirmatory due diligence rather than a completely ground-up review,” said Malcolm Parry, Partner at law firm Hogan Lovells Cadwalader. “The direction of travel is towards regulatory recognition rather than regulatory duplication,” Parry told Reuters Events. Different markets U.S. developers face government-backed UK competition. Great British Energy-Nuclear, a government-run body to accelerate nuclear deployment, has contracted Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver three reactors with combined generating capacity of 1.4 GW at Wylfa, a former nuclear site on Anglesey in North Wales, although the site could eventually accommodate eight units. Initial work at Wylfa is due to begin this year, with the first reactor due to become operational in the mid-2030s. The government has committed more than 2.5 billion pounds ($3.3 billion) to its wider SMR programme, which includes Wylfa. MAP: UK nuclear reactors Source: World Nuclear Association Government support for Wylfa gives Rolls-Royce a headstart over U.S. rivals. The company also has an established British supply chain, having spent more than 300 million pounds with suppliers since 2021, at least 70% of it with UK businesses. Holtec is evaluating the business case for a UK factory that could become a regional hub for component production, O’Brien told Reuters Events. U.S. developers can also draw on international manufacturing networks while building local partnerships, potentially allowing them to replicate reactor designs without duplicating production facilities. Westinghouse in September 2025 signed agreements with six British suppliers to support the construction of AP1000 and AP300 reactors in the UK and elsewhere. For exclusive nuclear insights, sign up to our newsletter. Yet Stewart Forbes, Counsel at Hogan Lovells Cadwalader, told Reuters Events that U.S. developers could gain an advantage from their much larger domestic market. “The economics of SMRs depend on repeat production and standardisation,” he said. UK government support for both pressurised-water SMRs and Generation IV advanced modular reactors, and the large size of the British energy market suggest that nuclear developers will be able to deploy “multiple fleets of different reactor designs,” the X-energy spokesperson said.

item.title: HSBC cuts global equities to 'neutral' on Middle East, AI risks
item.description: HSBC on Monday downgraded its stance on global equities to "neutral" from "max overweight", citing renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and worries over potential AI regulation ahead of the US midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: HSBC on Monday downgraded its stance on global equities to "neutral" from "max overweight", citing renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and worries over potential AI regulation ahead of the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"US midterm elections"]. "We've been max overweight stocks and max underweight sovereign bonds since mid-March. Given the constant narrative bingo we just can't have the same level of conviction any longer," HSBC said in a note. HSBC double-upgraded developed-market sovereign bonds to "overweight" from "max underweight" Sovereign bonds could see support either from a potential AI slowdown if Democrats win or from gridlock in the midterms that could ease fiscal worries, HSBC said "Betting odds may well be too confident on a 'Blue Wave'. item.title: Netanyahu destaca apoio de Trump na véspera de eleição e sugere que eles podem retomar guerra contra Irã
item.description: O primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, se gabou do apoio de Donald Trump na véspera das eleições em Israel, sugerindo que os dois líderes poderiam retomar sua guerra contra o Irã caso ele vença, depois que Trump afirmou que eles deveriam “concluir o trabalho”.
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Emily Rose
item.content:encoded: O primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, se gabou do apoio de Donald Trump na véspera das eleições em Israel, sugerindo que os dois líderes poderiam retomar sua guerra contra o Irã caso ele vença, depois que Trump afirmou que eles deveriam “concluir o trabalho”. “O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, trouxe uma amizade que nunca existiu antes entre um primeiro-ministro israelense e um presidente norte-americano. E é improvável que tenhamos novamente um presidente tão amigo”, disse Netanyahu em uma aparição na televisão na noite de domingo. “Ele ainda tem mais dois anos, e diz que está pedindo a vocês que votem em mim.” Em sua própria postagem nas redes sociais no domingo, Trump, que iniciou a guerra contra o Irã em conjunto com Netanyahu em fevereiro, afirmou: “Votem em Bibi Netanyahu para primeiro-ministro, temos que terminar o trabalho que começamos!” Netanyahu disse que Trump estava disposto a tomar medidas “que finalmente, finalmente, eliminariam a ameaça iraniana”, mas somente enquanto o próprio Netanyahu permanecesse no poder. “E eu já instruí o Mossad e as Forças de Defesa de Israel (IDF) a derrubar esse regime, a derrubar esse regime, porque essa é a única maneira de pôr fim a essa ameaça”, declarou Netanyahu, referindo-se ao principal serviço de inteligência e às Forças Armadas de Israel. A Casa Branca não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário sobre as declarações de Netanyahu. O principal adversário de Netanyahu, o ex-chefe do Estado-Maior das Forças de Defesa de Israel (IDF) e centrista Gadi Eisenkot, postou seus próprios comentários nas redes sociais, elogiando Trump como “um verdadeiro amigo de Israel”. “Valorizo seus esforços e seu compromisso com a segurança de Israel, e estou confiante de que ele trabalhará em plena cooperação com qualquer líder escolhido pelo povo.” A votação de terça-feira, a primeira em Israel desde os ataques do Hamas em 7 de outubro de 2023, é a primeira oportunidade para os eleitores se pronunciarem sobre a pior falha de segurança em gerações e as guerras em várias frentes que se seguiram. Com Netanyahu já à frente do governo mais de direita da história de Israel, a política se deslocou ainda mais para a direita. Quase todos os partidos liderados por judeus, incluindo o do linha-dura Eisenkot, agora se opõem à “solução de dois Estados” que sustentou décadas de negociações de paz com os palestinos. Mas muitos eleitores afirmam que a política divisiva do líder mais longevo de Israel enfraquece o país. As pesquisas sugerem que o Partido Likud, de Netanyahu, perderá cadeiras, o que pode privar sua coalizão — formada por partidos de direita, extrema-direita e ultraortodoxos — de sua estreita maioria. Eisenkot e uma série de partidos da oposição — que vão desde o que restou da centro-esquerda até a direita — também não têm um caminho claro para destituí-lo.

item.title: Jordania detiene a tres familiares en relación con ataque mortal contra una iglesia: autoridades
item.description: Las fuerzas de seguridad jordanas detuvieron a dos hermanos y a su cuñado tras un tiroteo ocurrido el lunes a raíz de un ataque contra una iglesia en el que murieron nueve personas, y los sospechosos no parecen tener vínculos con otras células, según afirmaron altos cargos de seguridad del Gobierno.
item.dc:creator: Abdelhadi Ramahi, Eman Abouhassira, Nayera Abdallah
item.content:encoded: Las fuerzas de seguridad jordanas detuvieron a dos hermanos y a su cuñado tras un tiroteo ocurrido el lunes a raíz de un ataque contra una iglesia en el que murieron nueve personas, y los sospechosos no parecen tener vínculos con otras células, según afirmaron altos cargos de seguridad del Gobierno. "Si Dios quiere, solo actúan por su cuenta", afirmó el director de Seguridad Pública, el general de división Obeidallah al-Maaytah. Este tipo de violencia es muy inusual en Jordania, un aliado relativamente estable de Estados Unidos en Oriente Medio, y el atentado del viernes contra la minoría cristiana llevó al rey Abdulá a ordenar a las fuerzas de seguridad que respondieran con "mano de hierro". En una rueda de prensa, al-Maaytah y el ministro del Interior, Mazen al-Faraya, afirmaron que el país no tolerará el terrorismo extremista. "El caso aún no se ha cerrado; las investigaciones siguen en curso. A día de hoy, no hay indicios de que existan vínculos entre ellos y otras células", añadió. El ataque del viernes, perpetrado durante un funeral en una iglesia ortodoxa griega de la localidad de Hamoud, a unos 120 kilómetros al suroeste de la capital, Amán, también dejó al menos 34 heridos, lo que ha alarmado a la comunidad cristiana. Según testigos, los hombres armados abrieron fuego durante varios minutos. Los sospechosos, que vivían cerca de Hamoud, serán llevados ante la justicia, afirmaron los responsables de seguridad. Los nombres de los tres sospechosos se dieron a conocer en la rueda de prensa. Las imágenes de vídeo de Reuters mostraban un edificio acribillado por el intercambio de disparos en la localidad de al-Judayyda, en la provincia de Karak. La Dirección de Seguridad Pública dijo en un comunicado difundido por los medios estatales que las fuerzas de seguridad localizaron a los sospechosos mientras se escondían en una casa abandonada. Estos se negaron a rendirse y atacaron a las fuerzas de seguridad, que respondieron al fuego y detuvieron a los tres tras herirlos.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
item.description: Anthropic unveiled its US initial public offering paperwork on Monday, setting up for a blockbuster market debut that would test investors' willingness to fund the AI juggernaut's bills amid growing worries over the massive debt-fueled spending.
item.dc:creator: Deborah Sophia
item.content:encoded: Anthropic unveiled its US initial public offering paperwork on Monday, setting up for a blockbuster market debut that would test investors' willingness to fund the AI juggernaut's bills amid growing worries over the massive debt-fueled spending. The company had submitted a [USN:L4N4291D9 TEXT:"confidential filing"] in June. In the recent weeks, exclusive reporting from Reuters highlighted its [USN:L6N45L00I TEXT:"sweeping AI ambitions"], [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"mounting costs"] and concerns about the "[USN:L4N45K1J5 TEXT:"existential risks to humanity"]" that advanced AI poses. Here are a few details on Anthropic's financials, business structure, and where it stands in the global AI race: BACKGROUND AND FINANCES Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei, Anthropic is the startup behind the Claude family of AI models. Across four tiers - Fable, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku - Claude powers products such as Anthropic's chatbot, coding agent and the enterprise-focused Claude Cowork AI agent. Anthropic's early focus on training its models for coding tasks propelled the company to the forefront of the AI race and helped it draw a steady stream of enterprise customers. A majority of its revenue comes from businesses paying for its models per use, measured in "tokens" of information processed, in what Anthropic calls "consumption-based" revenue. It also generates revenue from its paid customer subscription tiers such as "Pro" and "Max". That has helped Anthropic grow its revenue to $4.59 billion in 2025 from $386 million a year ago and $41 million in 2023. For the six months ended June 2026, Anthropic's revenue was $16.29 billion. But the rapid growth is accompanied by bigger losses. Its operating loss for the first half of 2026 was $693 million. In 2025, it was $8.06 billion, up from $2.98 billion a year ago. COSTS, COMPUTE DEMAND AND CIRCULAR AI INVESTMENTS Computing power is Anthropic's biggest expense. The company's costs include computing fees paid to cloud services providers such as Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, costs tied to data center facilities and renting data center capacity, equipment leases and energy bills. Over the past three years, Anthropic's compute and infrastructure expenses have dwarfed its revenue. The company has committed more than [USN:L1N45K0RM TEXT:"$500 billion"] in spending with six partners over a decade - one of the largest AI buildout commitments on record. Anthropic said many portions of its agreements are non-cancelable or require payments regardless of usage. It has committed to spend at least $110 billion with Amazon (AMZN.O) , about $114.5 billion with Google (GOOGL.O) and $44.9 billion with Microsoft for cloud computing over the next seven to 10 years. But some of those companies are also its largest backers. Amazon and Google are among Anthropic's top shareholders, marking yet another example of the circular financing structures that have dominated capital flows in the AI industry. Amazon has invested at least $13 billion in Anthropic and has agreed to invest up to $20 billion more. Google has committed up to $40 billion to Anthropic. GOVERNANCE AND STRUCTURE Anthropic is a public benefit corporation, or PBC, meaning it is legally obligated to balance profitability goals for investors with developing AI for the benefit of humanity. An independent body elects a majority of its board. The company, helmed by Dario Amodei as CEO and his sister Daniela, as president and chair of the board, will continue to operate as a PBC after its listing. It expects to keep its founders and an independent trust in control, in a structure that could limit investor oversight and public shareholders' influence. The company has said it needs to concentrate control and capital in fewer hands to reduce AI's risks. Under this arrangement, a majority vote of its seven co-founders will direct a single share of Class F stock that amounts to 50.1% of the total voting power over key corporate matters, including the election of some board directors and other matters submitted to investors. COMPETITION Anthropic's most direct competitor is OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT, whose 2022 launch kick-started the global race to advance and adopt AI technologies. Following Anthropic's lead in the enterprise market, OpenAI has also sharpened its focus on products for developers and business customers. Anthropic is also locked in a race with Elon Musk's SpaceX and Alphabet's Google. All of them are spending billions of dollars into model development, data centers and specialized AI chips as they vie for dominance in generative AI. Ramp data, which captures a slice of AI spending by business customers, showed Anthropic accounted for 60.1% of AI token spending in the week ended October 11. The startup has gained ground against rivals increase spending on AI services.

item.title: Las refinerías rusas aumentan la producción de diésel tras el acuerdo con EEUU: fuentes
item.description: Las refinerías rusas están aumentando la producción de diésel en octubre después de que el Gobierno concediera cuotas de exportación a raíz del acuerdo de suministro alcanzado entre el Kremlin y Estados Unidos, según afirmaron dos fuentes del sector cercanas al asunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las refinerías rusas están aumentando la producción de diésel en octubre después de que el Gobierno concediera cuotas de exportación a raíz del acuerdo de suministro alcanzado entre el Kremlin y Estados Unidos, según afirmaron dos fuentes del sector cercanas al asunto. El presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, declaró el 9 de octubre que su par ruso, Vladimir Putin, había aceptado un acuerdo para suministrar gasóleo desde Rusia a Estados Unidos y a los mercados mundiales, a cambio de que Washington levantara temporalmente sus sanciones sobre el combustible ruso. Rusia confirmó el acuerdo y Trump señaló que Rusia entregaría más de 300.000 toneladas (unos 2,25 millones de barriles) de diésel de forma inmediata, seguidas de otras 500.000 toneladas en noviembre y 1 millón justo después. Afirmó que Rusia entregaría 3 millones de toneladas más, dependiendo del estado de sus refinerías. Los operadores señalaron que, a partir del 1 de octubre, el Gobierno ruso había concedido excepciones a su actual prohibición de exportación de gasóleo para establecer cuotas que permitieran a Rusia suministrar combustible en el marco del acuerdo con Trump. Desde que entró en vigor la prohibición de exportación de diésel ruso en agosto, sus empresas petroleras han tenido que recortar la producción para satisfacer las necesidades nacionales, al tiempo que limitaban los suministros a los países de Asia Central en virtud de acuerdos intergubernamentales. Fuentes del sector indicaron que la producción de gasóleo rusa descendió en la primera quincena de octubre a unas 160.000 toneladas diarias, frente a las 175.000 toneladas de septiembre. Tras la llegada de las nuevas cuotas de exportación este mes, la producción comenzó a aumentar hasta las 180.000 toneladas diarias. El consumo interno suele descender hasta unas 140.000 toneladas al día en octubre, según las fuentes, que aluden a factores estacionales como la finalización de la cosecha de cereales y la temporada de conducción del verano boreal. Esto dejaría al menos 40.000 toneladas al día, o más de un millón de toneladas al mes, disponibles para la exportación. De esa cantidad, entre 0,2 y 0,3 millones de toneladas podrían ser necesarias para los países vecinos, añadieron las fuentes.

item.title: B3 cita queda de 10% e aciona circuit breaker na abertura do pregão à vista após reeleição de Lula
item.description: A B3 acionou o "circuit breaker" nesta segunda-feira, suspendendo por 30 minutos a negociação dos ativos à vista, renda fixa privada e opções referenciadas em ações, BDR, Ibovespa, Ibovespa B3 BR+, IBrX-50, Índice Small Cap e ETFs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A B3 (B3SA3.SA) acionou o "circuit breaker" nesta segunda-feira, suspendendo por 30 minutos a negociação dos ativos à vista, renda fixa privada e opções referenciadas em ações, BDR, Ibovespa, Ibovespa B3 BR+, IBrX-50, Índice Small Cap e ETFs. O mecanismo foi acionado após queda de 10% em relação ao fechamento anterior, afirmou a B3, citando que comunicará em breve o horário de reabertura da negociação. Tal reação ocorre após reeleição de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para a Presidência, que contrariou as expectativas do mercado e trazia preocupações com o cenário fiscal do país. De acordo com agentes financeiros, o mercado havia se posicionado para uma vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no segundo turno da eleição, principalmente após o filho do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro liderar o primeiro turno. Investidores enxergavam uma mudança em Brasília como uma possibilidade de melhora das contas públicas do país. De acordo com as regras da B3, após um primeiro circuit breaker, se a queda alcançar 15% na volta das operações a negociação é novamente interrompida, então por 1 hora. Na volta, se cair 20%, a B3 pode determinar a suspensão da negociação por um período por ela definido. No mercado futuro, a B3 ampliou duas vezes os limites inferiores de oscilação diária para os contratos do Ibovespa - de 10% para 15% antes da abertura e após o início dos negócios elevou novamente o piso para 20%, em decisão que também inclui os mini contratos futuros do índice. Por volta de 10h10, o contrato com vencimento em 16 de dezembro afundava 16,74%, a 173.260 pontos.
